_source: docs/POTATO_VOICE.md §3. Verbatim. Fields in {braces} are live values (durations, numbers).
pickup: I was in the middle of something.
putdown: This is not where I was.

3h: I've had time to think. About you.
restored: Hello. It was dark. I've filed something.
I don't want to talk about it. It's in the File.
dark._restored_sample: Four hours, forty-five minutes. I counted.

immediate: I can see your feet from here.
20min: Is this a punishment or a test.

shake: Everything's loose now. I hope you're happy.
_drop_note: The empty string is the blank screen, one second.

48h: Day three. The plant is also here.
7d: The plant and I have an understanding now.
return_long: I assumed the worst. Then I assumed you were fine. Then I stopped assuming.

night: This had better be the Hum.
loud: I've told the Net about your music. They're sympathetic.
temperature: It's {temp_f} in here. Just so we're clear.
I have questions about the temperature. All of them are "why."
_temperature_sample: It's 63 in here. Just so we're clear.

settled: Don't tell me where we are. I'll work it out.

wifi_lost: The Net's gone. It's just us.
wifi_restored: Back. I missed {n_words} Bulletins. Give me a moment.
_wifi_restored_sample: Back. I missed two Bulletins. Give me a moment.
saturday: It's Saturday. You're allowed. I'm noting it anyway.
